raw_response:
I'm 75, been working this same ground more than half a century. Only me and the old woman left in the house now — children moved away years ago. 5 mu isn't much, but it's enough to feed us and sell a little. I'll do what I did last year, like always. Changing things at my age is asking for trouble.

**Wheat (winter, 5 mu):**
I plant wheat in October after the maize comes off. I buy the same improved seed from the agricultural shop in town — I think it's 济麦 something, neighbor Old Wang uses it too and gets good harvest. About 15 kg seed per mu, a little heavier because I'm old and can't always get the drill depth just right, so more seed makes up for poor stand.

For fertilizer, I put down 2 bags of 复合肥 (15-15-15) per mu before plowing — that's 100 斤 per mu, costs me about 150 yuan a bag. Then in spring when wheat is greening up, I broadcast about 30 斤 of 尿素 per mu, and maybe another 20 斤 at jointing if the leaves look pale. That's how my father did it, and how I've done it. Too little fertilizer and the wheat is thin — I'd rather spend a bit more than lose grain. A bad wheat crop means buying flour all year, that's shameful.

I water 3 times — once before winter so the roots don't freeze, once at green-up in March, once at grain filling in May. The well is in the village, I pay for electricity. I spray once for weeds in spring, once for aphids (蚜虫) around May when I see them on the heads. If rust (锈病) shows up I spray that too, so maybe 3 sprays total.

I rotary till before planting — the neighbor has a machine, I pay him 50 yuan per mu. No more plowing by ox, those days are gone.

Last year I got about 450 kg/mu. I expect about the same — weather and pests decide, not me.

**Maize (summer, 5 mu):**
Right after wheat harvest in June I plant maize. I use 郑单958 or whatever hybrid seed the shop recommends — everyone around me plants hybrid, nobody saves seed anymore for maize. About 2 kg seed per mu.

Base fertilizer: 1.5 bags of 复合肥 per mu (75 斤) at planting. Then when maize is about knee-high (大喇叭口期, big trumpet stage), I side-dress 40 斤 尿素 per mu. Maize eats a lot of nitrogen — if the leaves yellow early, the cobs will be small. I've seen this too many times.

Summer rain is usually enough, but the well is there if July is dry. I water maybe 2 times — once after planting to get it up, once at tasseling if no rain. I spray once for 玉米螟 (corn borer) — the village loudspeaker tells us when. Maybe one more spray if armyworm (粘虫) comes.

No-till for maize — I just drop seed in the wheat stubble with the little machine Old Wang's son operates. Cheaper than tilling twice a year.

Last year maize was about 550 kg/mu. I expect similar.

My total fertilizer bill for the year is maybe 2,000 yuan. Seed another 500-600. Pesticide and water maybe 400-500. After selling grain, what's left is not much, but enough. My pension and my son's money from the city help too.
